LAST CHOPPER OUT

Quang Tri, 1968
HOW TO PLAY
MoveWASD / arrows (stick or drag on touch)Shootingautomatic: keep Doc and your Marines aliveSpecialSPACEPatchH Doc · Q a MarineCall the birdX on the PAD circlePop smokeautomatic on the PAD (G / pad X: at once)Confirm smokeY / Enter ours · N / Esc not oursBunkerE: step in for cover, still shootEngineershold F at a firebase call pointLevel-up1 / 2 / 3 pick · R reroll · B banishPauseEsc / P · Mute M
Controller (Xbox / PlayStation / Steam Deck, plug in and press any button): not connected
✦ For the Marines, Navy corpsmen, and all who served alongside them in Quang Tri, 1968. ✦
A stylized arcade tribute to the Marines who served in Vietnam.
Mature: stylized violence — stylized pixel blood & gore.
Credits & audio licences

Dedicated to Gunnery Sergeant R. Lee Ermey, USMC (1944–2018), who trained Marines and served in Vietnam. Semper Fidelis.

PHOTOGRAPHS (public domain, US government)

Marines offload from a CH-46, Operation Auburn, Quang Nam, c. January 1968. U.S. Marine Corps photo, National Archives at College Park (via DPLA / Wikimedia Commons). Public domain.

Marines offload a CH-53 at Khe Sanh, 23 January 1968. U.S. Marine Corps photo, National Archives and Records Administration (via DPLA / Wikimedia Commons). Public domain.

1st Battalion, 4th Marines build a bunker at Con Thien (C-4), January 1968. Department of Defense (USMC) photo A190197. Public domain.

155mm howitzer, Battery W, 1/13 Marines, Khe Sanh, 1968. Department of Defense (USMC) photo A190292. Public domain.

PBR crewmen check a junk's papers on the Perfume River, Republic of Vietnam, 20 August 1968. Photo by LT Storck, National Archives 127-GVC-127-A704280 (via Wikimedia Commons). Public domain.
